title: Easily Add Action Items
author: Neal Mitchell
content:
New feature in fastProject 4.7.3 is the ability to quickly add Action Items into the notes on specific tasks.

The actions can be added during the Update as well as used to record actions during Pull-in sessions with the team.

Also introduced in this version is the use of right-mouse-click functionality for the most common tools used in the Quick Access Toolbar and the Tools menu. The action item can be entered here as well using the context sensitive right-mouse-click over the task.

Quickly add action items during team Pull-in sessions.

Quickly add action items during the Update. Notice that the "noted" task is automatically highlighted in yellow to help locate it later. This is done when the "Add Action" function is selected (including he date stamp for the action).

And view the action items from the day by Tools/Add Action/Show Today's Actions.
